s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The colored dividers split the canvas into equal-sized cells. Copy the
    # pattern from the upper-left cell into every other cell.
    rdiv = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 3)
    cdivs = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] != 3 for row in grid)]
    # dividers have a color distinct from the background; take the two internal vertical lines
    cdivs = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] and grid[i][j] != 3 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    top_h = rdiv
    left_w = cdivs[0]
    rh = [0, rdiv + 1]
    cw = [0] + [j + 1 for j in cdivs]
    base = [row[:left_w] for row in grid[:top_h]]
    for r0 in rh:
        for c0 in cw:
            if r0 == 0 and c0 == 0: continue
            for i in range(top_h):
                for j in range(left_w):
                    if base[i][j] != 3:
                        out[r0+i][c0+j] = base[i][j]
    return out
'''

s='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg]
    r_bounds = [0] + [i + 1 for i in rows] + [h]
    c_bounds = [0] + [j + 1 for j in cols] + [w]
    # Use the upper-left compartment as the pattern and repeat it in each compartment.
    rh, cw = r_bounds[1] - r_bounds[0], c_bounds[1] - c_bounds[0]
    base = [grid[r_bounds[0]+i][c_bounds[0]:c_bounds[0]+cw] for i in range(rh)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(r_bounds)-1):
        for ci in range(len(c_bounds)-1):
            r0, c0 = r_bounds[ri], c_bounds[ci]
            if ri == 0 and ci == 0:
                continue
            for i in range(min(rh, r_bounds[ri+1]-r0)):
                for j in range(min(cw, c_bounds[ci+1]-c0)):
                    if base[i][j] != bg:
                        out[r0+i][c0+j] = base[i][j]
    return out
'''
